title: Room 312
subtitle: Diplomatic envoy found suffocated in luxury suite with deadbolted door.

briefing.summary: Attaché Sophia Chen was found dead in her third-floor suite during a bilateral trade summit. The electronic lock recorded no visitor card transactions.
briefing.objective: Expose the elevator master override and master keycard misuse to uncover who bypassed the digital lock.
requiredSolveConditions: Cross-examine keycard logs against elevator service telemetry

suspects.name: Andre Dupuis
suspects.profile: Polished hotelier with secret high-stakes debts in overseas sports books.
suspects.initialAlibi: Claims he stayed behind the front desk lobby from 21:00 until midnight.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Where were you between 21:00 and 22:30 when Sophia Chen was killed?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: I was stationed right behind the front concierge desk greeting international delegates all night. I never stepped foot on the guest room floors. Ask anyone who entered the lobby.

interrogationTopics.questionText: We understand you have urgent financial demands from offshore sportsbooks.
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: My personal finances are entirely private! I run a five-star hospitality operation. A few unlucky wagers don't make me a killer.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Who holds authorization for the service elevator override and utility closets?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Only senior management and engineering hold those keycards. Badge AD-01 is assigned directly to me, which proves our security protocols are air-tight.

confrontations.defenseReaction: A telemetry log? Anyone could have used the override code.
confrontations.brokenReaction: Mon Dieu... the system recorded the manual override?! Look, I was ruined! The loan sharks gave me until midnight. I only wanted the bearer bonds in her satchel! She woke up... she screamed... I just held the pillow over her face to stop the alarm! I never meant for this to happen!
confrontations.newFactUnlocked: Confessed to using Badge AD-01 to bypass Floor 3, breaking in via the balcony, and suffocating Sophia Chen over bearer bonds.

suspects.name: Victor Reyes
suspects.profile: Diplomat from rival delegation under heavy press scrutiny.
suspects.initialAlibi: Attending gala ballroom on ground floor.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Did you see or hear anyone entering Suite 312 across from your room?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: I was at the gala ballroom on the ground floor until well past midnight toasted by dozens of diplomats and photographers. I never went up to the third floor until the sirens arrived.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Were there conflicts between your trade mission and Ms. Chen?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Political disputes are settled across the negotiating table with ink and compromises, detective. Not with brute force in private hotel suites.

suspects.name: Maria Santos
suspects.initialAlibi: Cleaning 7th floor penthouse under camera surveillance.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Can you verify where you were between 21:00 and 22:30?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: I was deep-cleaning the Presidential Penthouse on the 7th floor the entire evening. The security cameras at the 7th floor elevator lobby will prove I never went downstairs.

interrogationTopics.questionText: Are third-floor utility balcony doors usually unlocked?
interrogationTopics.initialResponse: Never! Those balcony ledges are hazardous. Only Mr. Andre keeps the master brass latch keys on his personal key ring. Housekeeping isn't allowed out there.

evidence.title: Coroner Report: Sophia Chen
evidence.summary: Asphyxiation by feather pillow between 21:30 and 22:00. No signs of forced door entry.
evidence.fullText: Autopsy confirms mechanical smothering. The door's electronic lock showed no signs of physical forced entry or lockpicking.

evidence.title: Service Elevator 2 Override Record
evidence.summary: Service Elevator 2 locked on Priority Service Mode to Floor 3 at 21:35 by Badge #AD-01.
evidence.fullText: Microcontroller logs show elevator 2 recalled to Floor 3 with master key #AD-01 (assigned to Head Concierge Andre Dupuis) at 21:35 and held for 15 minutes.

evidence.title: Andre Dupuis Statement
evidence.summary: Andre swears he never left the front lobby desk during the entire evening shift.
evidence.fullText: "I was stationed behind the concierge desk greeting delegates from 21:00 to 00:30. I never stepped foot on the guest room floors."

evidence.title: Service Closet Balcony Latch Audit
evidence.summary: Third-floor utility pantry balcony door unbolted, providing direct ledge access to Suite 312.
evidence.fullText: Technicians found the exterior window latch of Suite 312 unlocked. The adjacent service linen room connects directly across a 1-meter stone parapet.

evidence.title: Sports Betting Foreclosure Letter
evidence.summary: Andre owed $180,000 to syndicate; victim possessed briefcase containing cash bearer bonds.
evidence.fullText: Correspondence seized from Andre's staff locker demanding immediate payment by midnight.

evidence.title: Recovered Trade Delegation Bearer Bonds
evidence.summary: $500,000 in unlisted bearer bonds stashed behind air duct in floor 3 service pantry.
evidence.fullText: Matching serial numbers from victim's diplomatic dispatch satchel found tucked in ductwork inside linen room.

timeline.title: Service elevator manual override
timeline.eventDescription: Service elevator locked to floor 3 by Andre's card.

timeline.title: Andre claimed lobby vigil
timeline.eventDescription: Andre claims continuous presence at front desk.

contradictions.title: Service Elevator Log Breaks Lobby Alibi
contradictions.explanation: Andre claimed he never left the front lobby desk, but his individual security badge was logged overriding Service Elevator 2 directly to Floor 3 during the murder window.

solution.resolutionNarrative: Desperate to pay off crushing gambling debts, Head Concierge Andre Dupuis took the service elevator to Floor 3, crossed the utility balcony into Suite 312, smothered Sophia Chen, and stole her diplomatic bearer bonds.

hints.text: Examine the elevator system records against Andre's claim of remaining at the desk.
Badge #AD-01 was used to lock the service elevator on Floor 3 right when Sophia Chen was killed.
Andre's elevator keycard usage destroys his lobby alibi and exposes his balcony break-in path.
